locations.note: Former gang member Marcus Reed, now a detective, hunts a mole in the Organized Crime Unit through four syndicates across a street-by-street Manhattan in 2005.
The whole island is open, from Battery Park to Washington Heights.
Harlem, where Reed grew up and the Presidents Club holds its ground.
Washington Heights, the northern end of the map and the Magdalena Cartel's turf.
Battery Park at the southern tip, where the story's final confrontation plays out.
Grand Central, one of the landmarks recreated inside the open Manhattan.
